activity_summary: Your father stood in the door and did not come in. He said some fairy had been at your back, as one was at his reckoning in Lent, and that he would know that fairy's hand anywhere. It was the nearest he came to the five pounds. He went downstairs pleased, and you did not put a name to it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave him the gladness, and no name.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the line from the door, and left pleased.

facets.activity: Heard Father joke that a fairy had been at the back

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: Some fairy's been at my son's back, as one was at my reckoning in Lent.

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'd know that fairy's hand anywhere.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Then I am glad you are pleased.
